human_direct.instructions: Was this message personally written by a human specifically to the recipient, rather than generated by a system, bot, notification service, campaign, or list?

criteria.yes: Personally composed by a human specifically to the recipient.
criteria.no: Automated, system-generated, bot-generated, list mail, campaign, or not specifically written to the recipient.

category.instructions: Classify into exactly one category. HARD RULE: if human_direct is yes, category must be personal or work. Automated messages may use any category, including personal or work.

criteria.personal: Personal life, family, friends, finances, home, travel, purchases, health, appointments, or other non-work matters.
criteria.work: Professional or technical correspondence, conferences, recruiters, colleagues, business, or industry matters.
criteria.github: Notifications delivered by GitHub about repositories, issues, pull requests, commits, reviews, or discussions.
criteria.email_lists: Discussion-list mail where members converse, such as a technical or community mailing list.
criteria.newsletters: Only genuine recurring editorial newsletters or publications primarily intended to be read. Excludes marketing, promotions, and product updates.
criteria.potential_spam: Marketing, promotions, product updates, discounts, cold sales, recruiting blasts, or questionable bulk mail that is not clearly malicious.
criteria.spam: Scams, phishing, fake invoices, malicious mail, or junk with no legitimate purpose.

needs_action.instructions: Does this require the recipient to reply, decide, complete a task, provide information, pay, schedule, review something they are responsible for, or otherwise take action?

criteria.yes: The recipient needs to do something.
criteria.no: Informational only; no action is required.

urgency.instructions: Assign urgency independently of whether action is required.

criteria.urgency_1: Highest: needs attention today, someone is blocked, or a deadline/security risk is within 24 hours.
criteria.urgency_2: Medium: deserves attention within several days.
criteria.urgency_3: Lowest: no immediate time pressure; can wait or is merely informational.
